summary: Updated implementation plan in Mizo incorporating the Stored Fault Code (DTC) & EEPROM Reader module. When a flash file (.bin) or EEPROM dump (.bin/.eep) is opened, it automatically scans for stored active and pending error codes (Fehlerspeicher), displays standard SAE/OEM descriptions with Mizo explanations, and provides a 1-click feature to clear stored fault codes directly in the dump.
